odia: ଲଙ୍କା— ଗଡୁଁ ଯେତେକ ଜାତ, ସମସ୍ତେ ଅସୁରଙ୍କ ସୁତ
title: One verdict for everyone
literal_meaning: All who are born from Lanka’s fortress are sons of asuras.
explanation: The force falls on “all”: a shared place becomes a single verdict about everyone born there. The dictionary supplies the totalizing word and quotation; its Lanka entry separately identifies the mythological capital. Our critical reading notices how quickly this image shuts out individual differences. It can help us examine a sweeping accusation, but birthplace or descent does not establish anyone’s character.
meaning_odia: କଥାର ଜୋର “ସମସ୍ତେ” ଉପରେ—ଗୋଟିଏ ଜାଗାରେ ଜନ୍ମ ହେଲେ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଏକ ରାୟରେ ବାନ୍ଧିଦିଆଯାଉଛି। ଅଭିଧାନର ଲଙ୍କା ଶବ୍ଦରେ ପୌରାଣିକ ରାଜଧାନୀର ଅର୍ଥ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଛି। ଆମର ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଏହି ଚିତ୍ର ଦେଖାଏ କିପରି ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀର ନାମରେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିର ଭିନ୍ନତା ଲୁଚିଯାଏ। ଜନ୍ମସ୍ଥାନ ବା ବଂଶରୁ ମଣିଷର ଚରିତ୍ର ସ୍ଥିର ହୁଏ ବୋଲି ଆମେ ଏହି ରାୟକୁ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରୁନାହୁଁ।
english_summary: Our critical reading questions a single verdict imposed on a whole group.
odia_summary: ଗୋଟିଏ ନାମରେ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ଦୋଷୀ ଭାବିବାର ରାୟକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପଚାରେ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: After one team member breaks a promise, a friend declares that the whole team is alike. Another quotes the Lanka line and asks whether they have just made the same sweeping judgment. The expression is being examined critically, not endorsed as a rule about the team.
